summary: Practise IFRS S1 and S2 readiness, controls, and disclosure data coordination. Explore the five-day course and plan your team’s next steps.
lede: IFRS S1 and S2 implementation training helps finance, sustainability, risk, and reporting teams prepare traceable sustainability-related financial disclosures. Participants practise assessing materiality and data gaps, mapping governance and controls, and coordinating climate metrics and emissions data using spreadsheet-based tracking. They also work on risk processes and evidence chains to support consistent disclosures across functions.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who own, coordinate, or review IFRS S1 and IFRS S2 adoption, sustainability-related financial information, climate data, and disclosure controls.
modules: IFRS S1 and S2 Adoption Foundations
IFRS S1 Materiality and Data Readiness
IFRS S2 Metrics and Emissions Data
IFRS S1 and S2 Disclosure Drafting
IFRS S1 and S2 Implementation Roadmap
prerequisites: Prior exposure to finance, sustainability, risk, or corporate reporting is recommended. No coding or programming is required. Bring familiarity with your organization’s reporting workflows; access to Excel is useful for spreadsheet-based exercises.
